verdict.rationale: This story is a fair question for an immigration law firm, which could publish approval or success rates. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Siskind Susser advertising any approval or success rate, or giving a basis such as case counts, a time window or methodology on its own pages. The cited pages cover practice areas, client mix and the Visalaw AI product, none of which touch success-rate disclosure, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, any advertised approval or success rate comes with a stated basis — case counts, time window, or methodology — on the provider's own pages
